picker.title: Choose a program
picker.subtitle: Your weights and history carry over either way.
picker.standardBody: Workout A: Squat, Bench Press, Barbell Row. Workout B: Squat, Overhead Press, Deadlift. 5 sets of 5 reps at fixed weight (1 set of 5 for Deadlift). Complete all reps to increase weight next session.
picker.madcowBody: Ramped sets up to 1 top set per lift on a Heavy-Light-Medium schedule. Squat 3x/week, Incline Bench on light day. Progress weight weekly.

confirm.toMadcowBody: Your current weights become your five-rep max. A 4-week on-ramp starts you lighter and has you matching your best in week 4.
confirm.toStandardBody: Each lift keeps the top set it reached on Madcow as its working weight, and every set goes back to the same load.
confirm.endsWorkout: This ends the workout you have open.

standard.note: Same weight for all 5 sets. Complete all reps to add weight next session. If any reps are missed, weight remains the same.
standard.deadliftNote: Deadlift is one set of 5. Your legs are already worked from squats.
standard.customiseNote: Modifying sets or reps creates a custom variation. Automatic progression rules still apply.

madcow.subtitle: Sets and weights are calculated from each lift's top set. Adjust the top sets, not the ramp.
madcow.onrampNote: Deliberately light. In week 4 you match your old best, and you set records after that.
madcow.matchingNote: This week's top sets equal the weights you came in with.
madcow.recordNote: Every top set from here is a personal record.
madcow.dayANote: 5 ramped sets (adding weight each set) of 5 reps, ending at this week's target top weight for Squat, Bench, and Row.
madcow.dayBNote: Light day. Squat: 4 sets of 5 reps (sets 1-3 ramp, set 4 repeats set 3). Press and Deadlift progress independently on this day.
madcow.dayCNote: Medium day. 4 ramped sets of 5, then a heavier triple, then a back-off set of 8 at set 3 weight.
howSteps: Workouts run in order: A, B, C. When starting Madcow, always begin on Workout A.
Workout A (Monday): 5 ramped sets (adding weight each set) of 5 reps for Squat, Bench, and Row. Set 5 is your target top weight for the week.
Workout B (Wednesday): Light squats, plus heavy top sets for Press and Deadlift. Press and Deadlift progress weekly on this workout.
Workout C (Friday): 4 ramped sets of 5, then a triple (3 reps) one increment above this week's top weight, ending with a back-off set of 8 reps.
Weekly progression: Hit all 5 reps on Monday's top set to increase your top weight by one increment next week. If you miss reps, repeat the same weight.
madcow.secondPressNote: Madcow's light day uses the incline bench, set to about 30°. Swap it for the overhead press if you'd rather keep pressing overhead.
madcow.topSetsNote: Workout A's heaviest set of five. Every other set is worked out from it.
madcow.setIntervalNote: Percentage step between ramped sets. Default is 12.5%.

technique.hint: Tap a lift to see how to perform it.

squat: Place bar on upper back (traps) and unrack.
Step back and set feet shoulder-width apart, toes turned 30° out.
Brace core and look at a spot on the floor 2 metres ahead.
Squat down by pushing knees out and bowing at hips.
Lower until hip joint is below top of knees (below parallel).
Drive hips straight up to stand, keeping knees pushed out.
Lock hips and knees at top. Rack bar safely.
bench: Lie on bench with eyes directly under bar.
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width with feet flat on floor.
Pinch shoulder blades together, drive into bench, and unrack bar over shoulders.
Lower bar under control to lower chest/sternum, keeping elbows tucked at ~75°.
Press bar up in a slight diagonal arc toward shoulders to lockout.
Rack bar securely after final rep.
row: Stand with feet hip-width apart and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Hinge at your hips until your torso is about 30–45° above horizontal.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Let the bar hang below your shoulders.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest or upper abdomen.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the bar under control to full arm extension.
After the final rep, stand up and lower the bar safely.
press: Stand with bar resting on front shoulders, grip just outside shoulder width.
Keep forearms vertical under bar, feet shoulder-width apart, and squeeze glutes.
Press bar straight up, tilting head back slightly to clear chin.
Move head and torso forward under bar once cleared, locking out over shoulders and mid-foot.
Lower bar under control back to front shoulders.
deadlift: Stand with bar over mid-foot (2-3 cm from shins), feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at hips and grip bar shoulder-width without moving bar.
Bend knees until shins touch bar.
Lift chest to flatten back and pull slack out of bar.
Drive through feet and drag bar up shins and thighs to lockout.
Stand tall without leaning backward at top.
Lower bar by hinging hips back first, then bending knees once bar clears knees to return to floor.
incline: Set bench to 30° angle and lie down with eyes under bar.
Grip bar slightly wider than shoulder width with feet flat on floor.
Pinch shoulder blades together and unrack bar over upper chest.
Lower bar under control to upper chest (below collarbone).
Press straight up to full arm extension over shoulders.
Rack bar securely after final rep.
